title: Best Budget Stays & Hostels in Maun
description: The best budget accommodation in Maun, Botswana — from iconic backpacker hostels to riverside lodges. Curated from real Reddit reviews and traveler tips. Includes prices, map, and honest verdicts.

places.name: Old Bridge Backpackers

redditQuotes.text: The backpackers has everything you need — friendly staff, comfortable beds, warm showers, a fully stocked bar, and a very decent kitchen. The views and atmosphere in the bar area are great.
I stayed at the Old Bridge Backpackers and it was great and lively. If you're on a budget, a campsite is your best bet. They also had a pizza oven which was great.

comparison.best for: Iconic Hostel in Thamalakane River, Maun with a $10 · Ensuite tent ~$55/night spend range
comparison.strengths: 3.5★ Google rating · Iconic Hostel · Thamalakane River, Maun
comparison.why it made the list: The undisputed #1 hostel in Maun. Situated right on the Thamalakane River, it's the social core of the Maun backpacker scene — meet other travelers, arrange Delta trips, and watch the sunset from the bar deck. The food is solid (especially the pizza), the staff are genuinely helpful, and the mokoro booking service is one of the most trusted budget Delta options around. Start here.

places.name: Audi Camp Backpackers
places.priceRange: 185/person · Luxury tent P1,400 double with breakfast

redditQuotes.text: Audi Camp is situated on the banks of the Thamalakane River, 12 kms from the center of Maun. We have 4 en-suite luxury tents on raised wooden decking. Surrounded by water and great food, it's an old-school safari experience.
redditQuotes.source: — Audi Camp website · Audi Camp, Maun

redditQuotes.text: People were talking about Audi Camp as well. It's apparently great. Originally called Maun Rest Camp, this is now owned and managed by Old Bridge Backpackers across the river!

places.verdict: Audi Camp is the classic Maun choice for travelers who want a quieter, more traditional safari atmosphere than the lively Old Bridge scene.

redditQuotes.text: We ended up staying here for two nights — P100 per person per night + P35 if you want to use the electric socket at the campsite. Great camping.
redditQuotes.source: — TripAdvisor review of Maun Rest Camp

redditQuotes.text: Nowadays you can find budget accommodation in Kasane and Maun. From there, you can use either a rented vehicle or a local tour operator. Botswana does not have to be as expensive as people think.

places.name: Discovery Bed & Breakfast
places.address: Outskirts of Maun, traditional village setting

redditQuotes.text: Accommodation was clean, comfortable and very attractive. Set in a lovely garden and decorated in a charming Botswana theme. Dinner was excellent, featuring traditional dishes, and breakfast was delicious. Our hosts and their team were friendly, informative and efficient.
redditQuotes.source: — Booking.com verified review · Discovery Bed and Breakfast

redditQuotes.text: Just a wonderful place. The staff is amazing and the dinner was delicious. Highly recommend you stay here to start off your Botswana adventure.

comparison.best for: Charming B&B in Outskirts of Maun, traditional village setting with a $60–$100/night spend range
comparison.strengths: Charming B&B · Outskirts of Maun, traditional village setting
comparison.limitations: for a first-night cultural welcome to Botswana it's worth every pula
comparison.why it made the list: The hidden gem pick. Discovery B&B scores a remarkable 9.1/10 on Booking.com — almost unheard of in Maun — and the reason is clear: genuine warmth, beautiful traditional architecture, and food that actually reflects where you are. Nine thatched huts in a garden setting beats a generic guesthouse room every time. At $60–$100 per night it's not the cheapest, but for a first-night cultural welcome to Botswana it's worth every pula.

places.name: Riley's Hotel (Cresta Riley's)
places.address: On the Thamalakane River, central Maun

redditQuotes.text: Cresta Riley's offers any visitor to Maun a warm welcome in true African style. Located on the banks of the Thamakalane River, it has free WiFi, free parking, and is convenient to Maun Gardens.
Compare prices and find the best deal for Cresta Riley's Hotel. Rates from $73. A historic property right in the center of Maun — the most central proper hotel option.

comparison.best for: Historic — Central in On the Thamalakane River, central Maun with a $73/night spend range
comparison.strengths: 3.8★ Google rating · Historic — Central · On the Thamalakane River, central Maun
comparison.limitations: historically significant and very convenient for early-morning safari departures
comparison.why it made the list: Maun's most storied hotel. Riley's has been welcoming travelers since the early days of Botswana tourism — before the Delta was famous, this was where explorers and pilots stopped for a beer. Today it's run by Cresta Hotels and offers the most reliable mid-range facilities in the center of town: pool, restaurant, WiFi, and proper beds from $73. Not glamorous, but historically significant and very convenient for early-morning safari departures.

places.name: Maun Lodge

The average room rate for Island Safari Lodge in the past month is 948.26 BWP, while Maun Lodge offers competitive pricing — from $89 for a quality stay with pool access.

places.verdict: Maun Lodge is the best-value option if you want a "proper hotel" with a pool and spa without paying mid-range luxury prices.

redditQuotes.text: Wonderful! 10 — Excellent overnight stop. 9.0 Wonderful overall. The lodge is in a stunning setting with incredible river access. Scores highest among mid-range Maun options.

Absolutely good value for money, overwhelmingly friendly owners, great services, great chalets, nice food and stunning atmosphere. Full heartedly recommending.

comparison.why it made the list: The romance pick in Maun. Yes, $200–$300+ per night is a genuine splurge by Maun standards — but the hippos literally surface below your deck at dusk, the breakfasts are cooked to order, and the owners run the place with real passion. Horseback riding along the river is an experience you won't find at cheaper options. Perfect for honeymooners, anniversary trips, or anyone who wants to arrive at the Okavango Gateway in style.
